## Selected work

### Vernissage

Hang your own exhibition of 8,263 public-domain works from The Met and the Cleveland Museum of Art, then walk through it in 3D with whoever opens the link. One Go binary serves the API, the WebSocket hub and the deep-zoom tiles.

<a href="https://vernissage-pi.vercel.app"><img src="assets/vernissage-tour.webp" width="100%" alt="A short tour of Vernissage: choosing works by colour, zooming into a painting, and walking into a 3D room with other visitors."></a>

<sub>Go, PostgreSQL, Next.js, React Three Fiber, WebSockets</sub> · [live](https://vernissage-pi.vercel.app) · [code](https://github.com/Nafiz001/vernissage)

### Databases and servers from scratch

| Project | What it is | Links |
|---|---|---|
| **quill** | A SQL database in Go: a B+tree on slotted pages, a write-ahead log with crash recovery, and the PostgreSQL wire protocol, so `psql` connects to the live read-only demo.<br><sub>Go</sub> | [live](https://quill.130-210-37-18.sslip.io) · [code](https://github.com/Nafiz001/quill) |
| **gedis** | A Redis-compatible store that speaks RESP, so the official `redis-cli` talks to it, with replication, AOF persistence and eviction. A public instance takes connections.<br><sub>Go</sub> | [live](https://gedis.130-210-16-198.sslip.io) · [code](https://github.com/Nafiz001/gedis) |
| **lumen** | A search engine with only Go's standard library: a crawler, an inverted index, BM25 ranking and snippets, live over the Go blog's 400 pages.<br><sub>Go</sub> | [live](https://lumen.130-210-16-198.sslip.io/?q=goroutines+channels) · [code](https://github.com/Nafiz001/lumen) |
